_doc: Bellmere props (generated from the town layout script; yaw in degrees, 0 faces +z north). Bridges have a box collider that carries the deck; canal walls tile every 8 m with the water side (+z) toward the water and their tops level with the street; the clock tower, keep, bridges, the silos and every few houses (the town_lm_* kinds) are landmarks with horizon impostors.

place._: Bridges: the Plaza Bridge and Cross Bridge over the Bell Canal, the Willow Bridge and North Bridge over the Willowrun. Box colliders carry the decks.
Market Plaza (760, 232): cobbles, the clock tower on the north-east corner facing the plaza, stalls, fountain, lamps.
Bell Canal: stone walls both sides every 8 m (tops level with the street), the walled basin at its head, quays with houses.
Willowrun through Bellmere: canal walls both banks (front face at the water edge), water stairs in a few gaps, quays with houses.
Bellmere Harbour: a walled basin with a quay, warehouses, carts and crates.
Streets: houses on both sides, lamps every 12-14 m, cobbles on the level stretches.
Old Town hill (630, 375): ring terraces 3 m apart, houses facing out over the town, stairs between the rings, a summit green.
The keep on the east hill (1440, 292), the fenced switchback road climbing to it.
Outskirts: Hollin Farm by the west road, orchards on the hill foot, the north fields and their farmstead, hedgerows.
